resolution: Email33 is a Runtime-only change from Email32. Runtime30 lets an owner connect a mailbox on the Runtime's own credential form with mail-server details and a password: an opt-in endpoint_policy {"mode":"public_addresses"} admits any public mail server under the existing all-addresses-public, pinned-address and certificate checks; a refused or unreachable login reopens the same page, with failed checks capped at five per hour per owner and connection target; a failed or abandoned replacement is released only when nothing was stored; and an opt-in registration_admission "host_authority" accepts a registration that the configured Host confirms over the existing form authority call, kept in an encrypted registration book. Without the two new settings behaviour is unchanged. App12 is unchanged from Email32. No Host contract changes: the form authority route is byte-identical from Host138 through Host143. Both Kit42 consumers retain the exact published Host134 bytes, producer metadata and corresponding source. The detached Email33 manifest must resolve final source and public artifacts; this template does not claim CI, publication or live deployment acceptance.

email.kit_compatibility: Host138 must be deployed before this App. Both consumers retain exact Host134 Kit alpha.42 with app-owned domain modules. Runtime30 preserves all fresh provider, OAuth, external-image, commit and disclosure guards and Send exact-message review; timing diagnostics never supply authority. App12 is unchanged from Email32.

supported_environment.runtime_platform: POSIX with durable private storage and HTTPS

limitations: Operator-managed developer preview, not production Gmail/Outlook parity.
Latency acceptance requires measured current Host and Runtime callback, cached compose and sync-page results; a build alone does not establish those targets.
OAuth configuration, purpose-specific Host gates/keys, reviewed grants and durable Runtime custody are required.
Resource publication for Task/Knowledge integration needs separate reviewed finite or explicitly Host-issued until_revoked consent; technical renewal alone does not grant it.
